text: It should be your care, therefore, and mine, to elevate the minds of our children and exalt their courage; to accelerate and animate their industry and activity; to excite in them an habitual contempt of meanness, abhorrence of injustice and inhumanity, and an ambition to excel in every capacity, faculty, and virtue.
author: John Adams
reference: Familiar Letters of John Adams and His Wife Abigail Adams
locator: Letter 74, John Adams to Abigail Adams, Philadelphia, 29 October, 1775
